name: Saiyan Resolve
summary: Gains increasing attack speed as health drops below 50%.

name: Ki Strike
summary: Fires a focused ranged ki attack at the current target.

name: Ki Burst
summary: Blasts a line of enemies with a concentrated surge of ki.

name: Instant Transmission
summary: Teleports behind the highest-threat enemy and strikes instantly.

name: Super Kamehameha
summary: Unleashes a devastating full-board ki beam that incinerates targets in its path.

name: Nine-Tails Chakra
summary: Passively regenerates HP and resists crowd control duration.

name: Kunai Volley
summary: Throws a fast ranged volley at the current target.

name: Clone Snare
summary: Shadow clones overwhelm an area, damaging and slowing enemies caught inside.

name: Rasengan
summary: Charges forward with a spinning orb of compressed chakra that shatters defenses.

name: Rasenshuriken
summary: Hurls a colossal vortex of wind blades that decimates a large battlefield sector.

name: Rubber Body
summary: Reduces physical and blunt damage taken by 20%.

name: Gum-Gum Pistol
summary: Extends a heavy melee strike toward the current target.

name: Elastic Rush
summary: Launches forward through enemies and hits everything in his path.

name: Gum-Gum Gatling
summary: Unleashes a rapid barrage of stretching punches across close-range foes.

name: Gear Fifth: Giant Stomp
summary: Expands to titanic proportions and stomps the battlefield, stunning all nearby enemies.

name: Unyielding Will
summary: Converts taken damage into bonus attack power and tenacity.

name: Heavy Strike
summary: Delivers a slow, powerful close-range attack.

name: Rage Roar
summary: Challenges nearby enemies and braces himself against incoming damage.

name: Hardened Fist
summary: Covers fists in crystal armor, striking for heavy single-target stun and damage.

name: Founding Rumbling
summary: Triggers a massive seismic shockwave that grants massive shielding and damages all enemies.

name: Deduction
summary: Analyzes enemy weaknesses, granting +15% critical strike chance across the team.

name: Calculated Strike
summary: Exploits an opening with a precise attack.

name: Prediction
summary: Marks a priority enemy after anticipating their next move, leaving them more vulnerable.

name: Checkmate Trap
summary: Sets a tactical trap that roots and weakens incoming aggressive rushers.

name: Master Strategy
summary: Coordinates a flawless offensive wave, marking all enemies with extreme vulnerability.

name: Zero's Aura
summary: Increases all allied skill damage by 12% while alive.

name: Command Shot
summary: Makes a measured ranged attack against the current target.

name: Command
summary: Forces a priority target to stop acting for a short time.

name: Tactical Disruption
summary: Distorts battlefield signals, reducing enemy attack speed and movement.

name: Absolute Geass
summary: Issues an irresistible command that stuns all enemy units across the board.
